{{Quote|You saved me from making a very great mistake, Master Kenobi! Themis shall join the Republic, and all Separatists present shall be expelled.|Prince Lumon, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter">{{TCWComicCite|6.24|Runaway Starfighter}}</ref>}}
[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] '''Lumon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Themian]] who served as the ruler of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
At some point in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] Lumon received [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as well as [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Thax]] for negotiations over the explosive [[Ore/Legends|ore]] of [[Themis]]'s [[Themis moon|moon]]. Both parties wanted to convince Lumon to give them access to the [[Themis moon mining base|moon mines]] and their ore, which could become a very valuable power source. As the negotiations progressed, Lumon grew exasperated by Kenobi and Thax's bickering and, as a result, dismissed them.

When Kenobi later took his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]], he lost control of his craft, which had been sabotaged by [[Thax's agent]], on the Duchess's orders. Lumon immediately assumed that Kenobi wanted to force his hand by threatening to destroy the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and Themis along with it. Skywalker desperately tried to convince Lumon that his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] would never do such a thing, to no avail. Meanwhile, Thax was further trying to discredit the Jedi in the Prince's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], telling him that they were nothing but fanatics who were ready to sacrifice themselves and the [[Themian]] people for their cause. Lumon gave Skywalker ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to stop Kenobi, if the young Jedi failed, he would order his [[Themian Fleet|fleet]] to destroy Kenobi's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]. Before Lumon could carry out his threat, however, Kenobi requested [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Andor (Themian)|Andor]] of the Themian [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] to fire on his craft, to the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] great surprise.

Back in Lumon's [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room, a safe and sound Kenobi gave the Prince the evidence of Thax's treachery: a piece of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that sabotaged his fighter. Furthermore, in order to make the culprit reveal themselves, he bluffed by saying that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] could tell him who planted the droid. Out of fear of Kenobi's [[Mind trick/Legends|psychic abilities]], Thax's agent admitted that he was responsible for the sabotage and that the Duchess commanded him to do it. With her treachery revealed, Thax threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Lumon if Kenobi tried to get any closer. Skywalker arrived right in [[Time/Legends|time]] and disarmed the Duchess with his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Lumon subsequently decided that his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] would join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and expelled Thax from his world.

==Behind the scenes==
Lumon first appeared in the short [[2011]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[Runaway Starfighter]]'', first published in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.24|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.24]]'' . It was written by [[Mike W. Barr]] and pencilled by [[Andres Ponce]].
